title: NotificationChannel
description: A notification channel (PRP-99; body of admin_kind notification_channel). The endpoint is never a property of this document: it lives in Key Vault and is referenced by endpoint_credential (key_vault_secret only). The one exception is local_sink_url, a plain-HTTP loopback or compose-service URL for local development (core refuses local_sink unless NS_ENV=local). Rules the Pydantic projection drops (if/then) are pinned by tests/contracts/test_governance_a_notifications.py: local_sink requires local_sink_url and local_sink_url requires local_sink; endpoint_credential is null only with local_sink; a webhook channel needs hmac_credential unless local_sink.

kind.description: Transport. Open-ended: readers must tolerate unknown values. email is declared; PRP-107 may ship it not_built.

allowed_host.description: The one host this channel may call: a lowercase bare DNS hostname (no scheme, port, path or IP literal; the last label starts with a letter), checked against the egress allow-list at send time.

endpoint_credential.description: Key Vault secret holding the endpoint URL or transport settings. Null only when local_sink is true.

hmac_credential.description: Key Vault secret holding the webhook signing material. Required (non-null) for kind webhook unless local_sink.

local_sink.description: Deliver to local_sink_url instead of the vaulted endpoint. Core refuses it unless NS_ENV=local (PRP-107 clarification 7).

local_sink_url.description: Plain-HTTP loopback or compose-service URL with no query string or userinfo. Present when and only when local_sink is true.

key_vault_secret_reference.description: A CredentialReference narrowed to a Key Vault secret (a managed identity alone cannot hold an endpoint).
